lines.zh: 我在雪上踩出一串深坑
lines.en: I punch a line of deep prints in the snow.

lines.zh: 毛皮裹着我，走得摇摇晃晃
lines.en: Wrapped in fur, I waddle along.
My tail sweeps across the snow.
I walk with my back hunched.

lines.zh: 短腿在雪里拔得很费劲
lines.en: My short legs strain to pull free of the snow.

lines.zh: 我边走边嗅着地面的味道
lines.en: I sniff the ground as I go.
The ice-plain wind spins me about.

lines.zh: 我踩着结冰的水洼滑了一步
lines.en: I slide a step on a frozen puddle.
I follow the ice crack where snow is thin.

lines.zh: 我爪尖先落地，免得陷下去
lines.en: My claws touch first so I don't sink.
Every so often I stop to shake off snow.
I skirt around the stone pile.
I bury my snout in my fur collar.
I crouch, ears swivelling.

lines.zh: 我往爪子上哈了口白气
lines.en: I breathe warm air over my claws.

lines.zh: 冰原太安静，我不太习惯
lines.en: The ice plain is too quiet for my liking.
I count the ice blocks out on the flats.
I knock the snow off my quiver.
I run my tongue over my teeth.
The wind drops and I relax a little.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕到脚前取暖
lines.en: I curl my tail around my feet for warmth.

lines.zh: 我盯着雪里露出的草根
lines.en: I stare at roots poking through the snow.

lines.zh: 你走进冰原，我早就看到了
lines.en: You walked onto the ice and I saw you early.
I set an arrow to the string.

lines.zh: 你穿得这么薄，会冻僵的
lines.en: Dressed that thin, you'll freeze.
I tilt my head and copy your stance.
You don't belong on this ice.

lines.zh: 我鼻子抽动，记下你的气味
lines.en: My nose twitches, filing your scent.
My eyes shine bright against the snow.
You raise a hand; I take half a step back.

lines.zh: 我舔了下嘴唇，不怀好意
lines.en: I lick my lips, not kindly.
Let's see who moves first.
I squeal and my fur puffs up.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打得打了滚
lines.en: The blow sends me rolling.
Blood on snow is a shocking red.
I clutch my arm and pull back.
You broke my shot.
I grit my teeth and growl low.
The pain pins my ears flat.

lines.zh: 我从雪里爬起来，更凶了
lines.en: I rise from the snow, angrier.

lines.zh: 这点伤，对狗头人不算事。
lines.en: A kobold doesn't mind a scratch like this.
You'd better not come closer.

lines.zh: 那味道在冷空气里很清楚
lines.en: That smell cuts clean through the cold air.
That's food in your hand, isn't it?
I'll come closer, bow down first.

lines.zh: 冰原上找口吃的太难了
lines.en: Food is hard to find on this ice.
Give it to me and I won't shoot.
I sniff it; no ill intent in the smell.
I reach out a paw for it.
Why back away? I don't bite.
Half for me — that's fair.
I sit and wait. I'm patient.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得在雪上滑开
lines.en: You knock me sliding across the snow.
Fur against armour makes a muffled thud.
Don't step on my tail.
I look up and bare my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞进了雪堆
lines.en: That bump puts me in a snowdrift.

lines.zh: 我从雪里爬起来，抖了抖
lines.en: I climb out of the snow and shake.
You're taller, but I'm sturdier.
Bump me once and I'll remember.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，谁也不退
lines.en: We press together; neither backs off.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你靴上刮了一下
lines.en: My claws scrape your boot.

lines.zh: 我的洞穴够深，风进不来
lines.en: My burrow is deep enough to keep the wind out.

lines.zh: 你身上的毛不如我的厚
lines.en: Your coat isn't as thick as mine.
Come close; we'll share the warmth.

lines.zh: 我把最软的那块皮留给你
lines.en: I keep the softest hide for you.
Don't go out before the snow stops.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴可以给你盖脚
lines.en: My tail can cover your feet.

lines.zh: 这个冬天我们会熬过去的
lines.en: We'll last this winter.
Listen — the wind is crying outside.
I'm not much for pretty words.

lines.zh: 但我会把最后一块肉分你
lines.en: But I'll split the last of the meat with you.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块冻硬的兽皮
lines.en: I pick up a stiff, frozen hide.
This bone can be ground to a point.
I pick up an arrow dropped in the snow.
The iron nugget stings, but I take it.
I grip it in my teeth and drag it to my burrow.
This shiny thing is mine.

lines.zh: 雪下埋着的东西我最会找
lines.en: Nothing finds buried things like I do.
I stuff it into my fur.

lines.zh: 有用的留下，没用的扔了
lines.en: Useful stays, useless goes.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，确认能吃才收
lines.en: I sniff it twice before keeping it.

lines.zh: 你的脚印进了我的雪原
lines.en: Your prints came onto my snowfield.
I nock an arrow; you needn't walk further.

lines.zh: 第一个看见我的人要倒霉
lines.en: Whoever sees me first has bad luck.
I fix my aim on your knee.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也快不过箭
lines.en: Run fast; arrows are faster.
The cold helps; my arrow flies straight.

lines.zh: 你踩碎冰面的声音太大
lines.en: You crunch the ice far too loudly.
I count to three. Find cover.
I crouch low and raise the bow.
This time you stepped on the wrong ground.
My teeth are waiting too.
Draw it full. No more hesitating.
Only you and me on the snowfield.
I shoot first and ask later.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我闻得出
lines.en: You smell of iron; I can tell.
Right then. You'll do.
I track your heels.

lines.zh: 你向左，我的准星也向左
lines.en: You go left; my aim goes left.
I wait for the cold to make you shiver.

lines.zh: 雪太亮，你的影子很明显
lines.en: The snow is bright; your shadow shows.

lines.zh: 我绕着石堆换了个角度
lines.en: I circle the stones for a better angle.
Huddle behind your shield; I'm in no hurry.
My breathing stays even.

lines.zh: 你露头了，我的手指动了
lines.en: Your head shows, and my finger moves.

lines.zh: 这一箭要穿过你的护甲缝
lines.en: This arrow goes through the armour gap.
I nock another.

lines.zh: 你退到冰崖边了，看得见吗
lines.en: You're backing to the ice cliff. Do you see it?
The wind throws snow into your eyes.
My shadow lies small on the snow.
Ten more steps and I draw steel.
You can't hear my steps, can you?

lines.zh: 我把你的位置记在脑子里
lines.en: I hold your position in my head.
Don't look back. It won't help.
I've been waiting a long while.
Stop moving and you're harder to miss.
Just about right — one arrow more.
I lunge and snap at your leg.
The bow drops; my teeth are closer.
I duck in low and ram your knee.

lines.zh: 我一爪子撕开你的裤腿
lines.en: One swipe tears your trouser leg.
We tumble together in the snow.
I clamp down and won't let go.

lines.zh: 你抬腿，我就钻到你身后
lines.en: You lift a leg; I slip behind you.
This bite goes for your hand.

lines.zh: 我的重量比你想象的大
lines.en: I weigh more than you'd think.
Up close I'm fast. Understand?
I drive you onto the ice.

lines.zh: 雪原上的血很快会冻住
lines.en: Blood freezes fast out here.
I hang off your bracer and shake.
Don't think short legs can't reach you.
I crash into your chest, claws first.
You've backed onto the stones.
I leap along your shadow.
Teeth are remembered longer than arrows.
That one should put you on your knees.
I'm not even winded yet.
The snow breaks and I climb out.

lines.zh: 冰原上多了一串小脚印
lines.en: A new line of small prints on the ice.
Ice still clings to my fur.
I know this wind by smell.

lines.zh: 我把弓弦拉了一遍，声音很脆
lines.en: I test the string; it snaps crisp in the cold.

lines.zh: 有人把猎物送到冰原上了
lines.en: Someone has delivered prey to the ice.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石堆后面，先看看
lines.en: I crouch behind the stones and watch first.

lines.zh: 雪原这么大，藏人很容易
lines.en: Such a wide snowfield hides people well.
I'm here, walking on fresh snow.
Don't turn. Listen for the arrow.
Cold weather clears my head.
I know this ice plain very well.
My fur catches and the stench is awful.
I land in a drift, legs first.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进毛里，我沉得快
lines.en: Icy water soaks my fur and I sink fast.

lines.zh: 雪和碎石一起砸在我背上
lines.en: Snow and rubble slam into my back.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肩上，我不该站着
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder — I shouldn't have stood there.

lines.zh: 那光一碰我，毛都竖起来
lines.en: That light touches me and my fur stands on end.
Hunger makes my legs weak.
Lightning hits the ice beside me.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我掉下去
lines.en: There's nothing under me and I fall.
